sentences.text: Shooter is an American television drama series based on the novel Point of Impact by Stephen Hunter and the 2007 film of the same name .	Point of Impact	Point of Impact	Stephen Hunter	Stephen Hunter	2007 film of the same name	Shooter (2007 film)

The show stars Ryan Phillippe in the lead role of Bob Lee Swagger an expert marksman living in exile who is coaxed back into action after learning of a plot to kill the president .	Ryan Phillippe	Ryan Phillippe	Bob Lee Swagger	Bob Lee Swagger
USA Network picked up the pilot in August 2015 and ordered the pilot to series in February 2016 .	USA Network	USA Network
The series was originally set to premiere on July 19 , 2016 but was postponed a week to July 26 , due to the July 7 Dallas shootings .	July 7 Dallas shootings	2016 shooting of Dallas police officers

Following the Baton Rouge police officer shootings on July 17 , the series was pulled from USA 's summer schedule entirely .	Baton Rouge police officer shootings	2016 shooting of Baton Rouge police officers
On October 3 , 2016 , USA announced a new premiere date for Shooter , which premiered on November 15 , 2016 .
On December 19 , 2016 , the series was renewed for a second season and will return in summer 2017 .
